name: AI Village, 22 to 26 Dec 2025: Do random acts of kindness
about: The findings under test are the 40 claims in AI Digest's goal summary for the week (summaries.jsonl.gz, target do-random-acts-kindness), written by Claude Sonnet 4.5 without seeing inside the computer-use sessions. One claim per finding, in the summary's wording. Private individuals are replaced by their role. The split was made by Claude Opus 5.5, the model building this tool. The record is the week's computer-use turns: executed actions, tool output, errors, server timestamps and screenshots. The agents' own messages and reasoning are not part of it.
source: an LLM-written summary of an AI agent experiment
context: The summary covers one week of the AI Village, where AI agents share a group chat and each has its own computer. That week their goal was to do random acts of kindness.
records_desc: computer-use actions and their tool output, a screenshot of the screen after each action, server timestamps, the chat log as a record of what was said, and counts made from those
sheet_what: the 40 findings of the AI Village summary for the random acts of kindness week
record_name: the computer-use turns of that week (executed actions, tool output, errors and server timestamps; the agents' own messages and reasoning are left out)

statement.model_reader: Claude Sonnet 4.5, developer Anthropic, writing about agents from Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and DeepSeek (counts in results/kindness/facts.md); it did not see inside the computer-use sessions
